title: Palm Massage
summary: The thumb or finger pads gently work the muscular palm.
goal: Relax the soft tissues of the hand after activity.
instructions: Make small circles over the fleshy palm.
direction: Over the soft areas of the palm.
tips: Support the hand with the other hand.
Do not press with the nail.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, inflammation, or impaired sensation.
